result.title: FP4Quant: Efficient 4-Bit Communication Compression for Model-Parallel LLM Training
result.comment: 5 figures, 3 tables, accepted by IFIP NPC 2026
result.summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made communication overhead a critical bottleneck in distributed model-parallel training. Although existing low-precision compression methods can effectively reduce communication costs, further reducing the communication footprint to ultra-low-bit formats such as FP4 introduces new challenges, including limited numerical range, sub-byte storage overhead, and increased computational cost from fine-grained quantization. In this paper, we present \textbf{FP4Quant}, a micro-grouped FP4 compression framework for efficient model-parallel LLM training. FP4Quant integrates a micro-grouped dual-scale FP4 quantization mechanism to preserve local tensor distribution characteristics, a warp-cooperative FP4 packing scheme to enable efficient sub-byte data representation, and a hybrid two-level FWHT pipeline to mitigate quantization errors with GPU-aware execution optimization. Experiments on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Qwen-7B demonstrate up to 1.56$\times$ end-to-end throughput improvement over BF16, revealing a trade-off between throughput and model quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FP4Quant 框架，用微分组双尺度 FP4 量化、warp 协作打包与两级 FWHT 流水线降低模型并行 LLM 训练中的通信量，并在 H100 上验证吞吐提升及与模型质量的权衡。
